CfxProperties.Name: twon
CfxProperties.Description: twiston threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the twiston effect can be executed

CfxProperties.Name: twoff
CfxProperties.Description: twistoff threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the twiston effect can be executed

CfxProperties.Name: wagon
CfxProperties.Description: sets the double-twist on threshold

CfxProperties.Name: wagoff
CfxProperties.Description: sets the double-twist off threshold

CfxProperties.Name: swon
CfxProperties.Description: Swing on threshold

CfxProperties.Name: pof
CfxProperties.Description: Power on Force threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the Power on Force effect can be executed. enables the Power on Force saber ignition technique (see paragraph 'Motion activated ignition' for more detail). The parameter defines the motion threshold required to ignite the blade with a motion faking the use of the 'Force' to activate the saber. 350-500 works usually fine.

CfxProperties.Name: blastm
CfxProperties.Description: Enables Blaster Move. Blaster Move allows the ability to trigger a sequence of blaster sounds with the motion of the hilt. Only the first sound is triggered by a short press on the aux. switch, then further �swing-like� gestures will trigger more blaster sounds, until a blaster sound ends, or if a clash interrupts the sequences (assuming blastp=0).

CfxProperties.Name: blastp
CfxProperties.Description: defines if the blaster priority is enabled or not. This decides if a clash can interrupt the blaster blocking sounds. Swings are always disabled during blasters. With the blaster priority on, the sound of the blaster must finish first then a swing might be executed. This allows a nice choreography for blocking blaster rays using a long blaster file without getting the sound stopped by a swing. If the choreography has stressed movements that might trigger a clash, set the parameter to 1 so that no gestural events can interrupt the blaster sequence. Conversely, if you wish a blaster sequence to be possibly interrupted by a clash, disable the parameter

CfxProperties.Name: random
CfxProperties.Description: set the selection mode for picking the clash, swing, spin and stab sounds.

Options.Description: the sound is randomly chosen in the available slots.
the sound is played in sequence. (slot 1, then 2 etc.)

CfxProperties.Name: pom
CfxProperties.Description: When set to 0, board will use current angle of the hilt to choose the power on sound played when saber is ignited by a motion; mode 1 as well but with the poweronf(orce) special sound played when initiating a force triggered (vertical shake) ignition (aka PoF). Mode 2 is random power on + special PoF sound, mode 3 is random at all times.

CfxProperties.Name: sbolt
CfxProperties.Description: list of 2 numbers, minimum and maximum size of the bolt impact. When set to 0,0 and in ledstrip mode, the bolt will make the whole blade to flash (legacy Flash on Clash)

CfxProperties.Name: dbolt
CfxProperties.Description: min and max of Bolt duration

CfxProperties.Name: lbolt
CfxProperties.Description: impact location restriction on the blade. In the example above, {15,30} forces the bolt to be at 15 pixel minimum from the bottom of the blade and 30 pixels away from the top of the blade.

CfxProperties.Name: fbolt
CfxProperties.Description: bolt impact energy distribution and edge fading / blending (in %). 100% will generate a solid flash all over the picked up size. 1% will have the center of the impact at the maximum brightness which will fade progressively down to 1% as you move to the edges of the impact.

CfxProperties.Name: rbolt
CfxProperties.Description: Bolt impact color randomization (in %). Provides some variance on the bolt color from impact to impact. Affect separately each RGB component in order to really alter the hue and not just brightness.

CfxProperties.Name: qbolt
CfxProperties.Description: Bolt impact speed (in %). Combined with the duration parameter (and bolt size range) it defines how fast it will travel on the blade when using certain blaster bolt styles (like wave). A ballpark is to see 100% speed as ensuring the bolt energy is sure to travel the whole blade during the bolt duration.

CfxProperties.Name: randc
CfxProperties.Description: Brings some color variance to FoC. Applies also to blaster in HB led mode (ledstrip blasters bolts have their own specific color parameters in ledstrip mode)

CfxProperties.Name: shmrd
CfxProperties.Description: duration of the shimmering effect of the high-power LED during a clash. Make sure this duration is not too much longer than the associated sound to keep a nice result.

CfxProperties.Name: shmrp
CfxProperties.Description: periodicity of the light bursts during the clash effect. A slow period will produce tight bursts.

CfxProperties.Name: shmrr
CfxProperties.FriendlyName: Clash: randomness of periodicity of light bursts
CfxProperties.Description: random value applied to the periodicity of the light burst during a clash effect. Allows having bursts that are not regularly spaced in time which increases the realism. For instance, a period shmrp of 20 and a random value shmrr of 10 will produce a period between two bursts varying between 20 and 30ms.

CfxProperties.Name: shmr%
CfxProperties.Description: Defines how the shimmer will "dig" the defined blade brightness during a clash or a lockup effect. A static flash is achieved by leaving that value to 0. That parameter is actually composed of 2 numbers separated by a comma to define the range to apply to the brightness modification during the shimmer.

CfxProperties.Name: focd
CfxProperties.Description: Flash on Clash duration

CfxProperties.Name: focp
CfxProperties.FriendlyName: Flash on Clash: periodicity of light bursts
CfxProperties.Description: periodicity of the light bursts during the Flash on Clash effect. A low period will produce tight bursts.

CfxProperties.Name: focr
CfxProperties.FriendlyName: Flash on Clash: randomness of periodicity of light bursts
CfxProperties.Description: random value applied to the periodicity of the light burst during a Flash on Clash effect. Similar to shmrr but applied to FoC

CfxProperties.Name: foc%

In addition, they can also have their own flicker specified by this parameter, in order to produce a more dramatic flickering effect on the cross-guard.

CfxProperties.Name: flks
CfxProperties.Description: A high value produces a damaged saber effect while a small value generates subtile energy changes. The value 0 disables the effect (static blade). Keep above 4 when using a ledstrip blade to avoid competing with the pixels (inherent) refresh rate.

A low value does not modify the energy very much while a high value � digs � big gaps of light intensity. To be used with the parameter flks. Set to 0 to obtain a static blade.

CfxProperties.Description: defines how to temper the instability. Low values make the blade return quicker to its stable while high values will make the blade overall more unstable / active.

CfxProperties.Name: lcool

CfxProperties.Name: mapb

CfxProperties.Name: mapc

CfxProperties.Name: refreshfx
CfxProperties.Description: defines in ms the refresh rate (and computation) of the ledstrip fx. It's supposed to be equal or greater to the flicker speed. Higher values (as a period) lead to slower refresh rate and can be used for slow effects like fire.

CfxProperties.Name: poi
CfxProperties.Description: power-on interrupt. With poi=1, motion is enabled once quick-on ignition has timed out (qon, per-font parameter, in font_config.txt). With poi=2, motion is enabled when ignition starts.

CfxProperties.Name: wakeup
CfxProperties.Description: defines if the board can be woken up (leaving sleep mode) by moving the hilt. When parameter is set to 0, and once the board has entered deep sleep mode, board can only be woken up by the blade ignition (activator) switch. When set to 1 or 2, motion of the hilt while the blade is off will reset the sleep timer which maintains the hilt in idle mode, hence playing the accent led sequence matching that mode. However, when parameter is set to 1, motion on the hilt allows the board to leave the sleep state, while being set to 2, motion will not allow the board to leave sleep once that state has been reached.

Options.Description: If the board is in deep sleep mode the board can only be awoken by the blade ignition (activator) switch.
Motion of the hilt will reset the sleep timer. Motion of the hilt will allow the board to leave sleep state.
Motion of the hilt will reset the sleep timer. Motion of the hilt will not allow the board to leave sleep state.
